body.zh: 新华、gov.cn、日喀则简报与@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus无新吉隆伤亡帖。中方仍为9月5日18时：43死、519失联、2人获救。NDRRMA最新仍为9月26日19:00 #25；RRN称至28日无新分项。堰塞湖已排空。中方口岸关闭。Rising Nepal 10月2日：Syabrubesi–Rasuwagadhi周事下午轻车重开。Samaya Post 10月3日：加尔奇—贝特拉瓦蒂一个月后重开。美使馆9月8日仍勿前往。
body.en: No new Gyirong casualty post from Xinhua, gov.cn, Shigatse, @XHNews or @CCTV_Plus. CN remains 5 Sep 18:00: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. Latest NDRRMA is 26 Sep 19:00 #25; RRN says no newer split through 28 Sep. Lake drained. CN gate closed. Rising Nepal 2 Oct: Syabrubesi–Rasuwagadhi reopened Tuesday afternoon for light vehicles. Samaya Post 3 Oct: Galchhi–Betrawati reopened after a month. US Embassy 8 Sep still do-not-travel.
body.ne: Xinhua/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus naya casualty chaina. CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. NDRRMA antim #25 (26 Sep 19:00); RRN 28 Sep samma naya chaina. Tal khali. CN gate band. Rising Nepal 2 Oct: Syabrubesi–Rasuwagadhi halka sawari. Samaya Post 3 Oct: Galchhi–Betrawati ek mahina pachi khulyo. US Embassy 8 Sep najau.
body.hi: Xinhua/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus naya casualty nahi. CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. NDRRMA antim #25 (26 Sep 19:00); RRN 28 Sep tak naya nahi. Jheel khali. CN gate band.
